Help center

Let's get you back in the game.

Noktaları Sırala requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later. Online features require an internet connection and a Game Center account.

Get support by email →

Alternatively, you may open a GitHub support request. A GitHub account is required and the request may be public. Never include passwords, phone numbers, or other sensitive information.

01

How do I update the app?

In the App Store, tap your profile icon, refresh the available updates, and tap Update next to Noktaları Sırala. If you use the TestFlight version, open TestFlight, select Noktaları Sırala, and tap Update.

02

Game Center is not connecting

Confirm that you are signed in under Settings → Game Center, check your internet connection, then fully close and reopen the app.

03

No opponent can be found

Matchmaking looks for another online player in the same league. If no match is found after a while, cancel and retry at the same time on both devices.

04

My rating or leaderboard is not appearing

Check your Game Center sign-in and internet connection. New scores may take a short time to appear in Apple's systems.

05

What should I include in a bug report?

Include your device model, iOS/iPadOS version, app version, and the steps needed to reproduce the issue. When appropriate, you may include a screenshot that contains no personal information.
